items.html: And it is found that what remains to ZA is only three Sefirot, which are: a third of Tifferet, Netzah, and Yesod. For although he also takes the two upper joints of the Hod, it was already clarified that the whole Hod is called by the name of Malchut. And it is found that ZA takes only three Sefirot, and the Nukva takes one Sefira, and she is a fourth to him, in the secret of “a fourth of a Hin” and the letter Dalet in the Name HaVaYaH, as is written in its place. And behold, now ZA is only three measures, and the Nukva is a fourth to him, and this is during the three days of absorption.
